newsitem.title: UK: Nomura launches new 50 billion yen JGB put warrant.
newsitem.headline: Nomura launches new 50 billion yen JGB put warrant.

text.p: Nomura International Plc launched a new JGB put warrant on Monday that will provide a long-term hedge for investors on the Japanese bond market, it said in a statement.
Nomura said the launch was designed to anticipate the publication of the Tankan Report on November 27, which is expected to increase levels of volatility in the JGB market.
The Tankan is a quarterly corporate survey conducted by the Bank of Japan and is closely watched by the financial markets as a clue to its future monetary policy.

"The problem for a lot of bond portfolios is how to express a bearish view on Japan with a sufficiently long-term horizon. Short-term hedges in the JGB market are available but involve roll-over costs which become expensive. Our warrant can solve this difficulty," Nomura International Markets Division director Fraser McKensie said.
Nomura said it would guarantee liquidity in the warrant by fixing a 200 yen (20 cents) bid/offer spread and by regularly updating this on a dedicated Reuters screen.
The warrant is American-style and can thus be exercised at any time.
The warrant will be listed on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange.
AMT 50 BLN YEN MATURITY 11.NOV.97 PAY DATE 06.DEC.96
